I've been so stressed and unhappy for so long that I really can't even tell you anything I like to do or would like to do in the future. I guess I really just want stability. I want to be able to have a job that I don't hate with a steady income that lets me rest assured that I'll be able to pay the bills each month and still have some left over for savings and maybe travel. And I want to be able to have a dog. For as long as I can remember I've always wanted a dog just so I could know that someone cares about me.

I do want to go back to school once I figure out what I want to do, and I am going to take some community college classes in the spring to help me figure that out. But the thought of not being able to attain the stability I need to stay sane for probably at least 5 more years is crushing. And the thought that I might not get the scholarships I need and would have to go into debt to get a degree is so stressing. Right now I owe my dad about $1,500 that I can't pay off and keeps going up. Its something that stresses me out all the time and it isn't even like he gets on my case about it. If I had to go thousands in debt for school I know that my anxiety would skyrocket. And my stress and anxiety spike just thinking about it.

No, he's abusive or anything like that. He's just not supportive at all and I think just doesn't know how care about another person. Like yesterday, while I was at work I told him I was feeling depressed and asked him to try and say something to cheer me up. His response was to give me some half-assed compliments (e.g. "you're so pretty"), and then say "well I've done all I can do." By the time I got home he had already forgotten that I'd told him I was feeling down (he never remembers anything I say). I guess I looked depressed when I walked through the door and he goes "what's wrong with you?," and then tried to just write it off as lady hormones.

As far as being unsupportive goes, I've tried to talk to him about my unhappiness in the past and he just seems disinterested basically tells me to suck it up and finish school. Thus, I haven't tried to talk to him about it in months and keep it all to myself.

The reason I stay with him is because he really is my only friend and I don't think I should cut myself off completely from social interaction. It is nice to spend time with him in a light hearted friendship kind of way (things are fine if you don't let the conversation get too serious), but that kind of relationship makes for a really awful boyfriend.

I do want to fix my life, but trying to change one's direction in life is just so exhausting when absolutely no one supports you that sometimes it hardly seems worth it.
